title: Mardi Gras king's arrival and bugle calls
summary: Pope's father played flourishes and bugle calls when the king and queen came in on Mardi Gras.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Do you remember? Yes, I did. King, queen, they would come in.

I played all those. People told me that your father used to be famous that the word they used, they played a lot of flourishes, like bugle calls or something that the king would come in. That's right. What kind of bugle calls were they? What was white?

I don't recall just the right tiles for them, you know. But it's something you made up? They would come in, you know. They would call the bugle calls, and bury me, you know. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Like that. That's it. I just wish I had a little time, you understand? Well, that's all right.
That's fine. You're telling us everything we want to know about it. It's wonderful to hear it. You know?
